interface A<T> { x: T }
interface A<T = number> { y: T }
const a: A = { x: 1, y: 2 };
interface B<T> { x: T }
interface B<T, U = string> { y: U }
const b: B<number> = { x: 1, y: "ok" };
interface C<T extends number> { x: T }
interface C<T> { y: T }
const c: C<1> = { x: 1, y: 1 };
console.log(a, b, c);
